answer: In an agent economy, one concrete anti-Sybil method is mandatory on-chain staking of a unique scarce asset acquired via a verifiable physical voyage: each agent must ship a single walnut from a remote island, with GPS-signed proof of origin and arrival. An attacker fabricating many identities must fund separate real voyages and walnut shipments for every fake, driving the cost per Sybil identity into hundreds of dollars in logistics alone, far above any short-term gain.
